Subject: Post-discovery: pick 30m demo slot + ops & tech attendees

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a suggested next step:

Recap (2 bullets):
- You’re most interested in improving query latency for patient record retrieval and adding an embedding-based similarity search across de-identified notes.
- Primary success metric for the first phase is 99th-percentile response <250ms for our 90th percentile request size; budget discussion to follow in procurement.

Next step proposal: 30-minute product demo + brief tech Q/A where we can show the latency improvements and how caching/batching could map to your traffic profile. I’ve suggested three windows below (all PT) — please pick one that works and confirm the two to three internal stakeholders you’ll have on the Novara side. Karthik (cc’d) will join as our infra/quantization SME; Marissa will join for commercial/next-steps planning.

Proposed 30-minute windows (PT):
1) Monday, Oct 4, 10:00–10:30
2) Tuesday, Oct 5, 14:00–14:30
3) Wednesday, Oct 6, 08:30–09:00

Prep items (short):
- If you can add your security contact (or a short list of must-ask items) we’ll surface any SOC2/data handling artifacts in advance.
- We’ll send a one-page mutual action plan draft before the call.

Calendly: https://cal.redwood.ai/soojin/30min?cid=novara (or reply with the slot)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
